## queue-replay-shared-frozen: queue reads share one frozen replayed state instead of a deep copy each

- `local` (Ops #713; the owner via COO rm-c05aad8c, chat-open speed fix 6b; plan approved in Ops lead). Hypothesis (H-QUEUE-REPLAY-2): after `queue-replay-incremental`, `replayState` + `pi-queue` `branchState` still took 4.5–5.3% of the main thread in #701's 30 s profiles, 3.1–3.3% of it `structuredClone`: every read deep-copied the whole kept state (`cloneReplayState` here, `cloneState` in `pi-queue` `replay`), and `branchState` walked the whole branch again (`getBranch`, 0.3–1%) on every appended entry. Handing every read the same state, frozen all the way down and made again only when a queue entry is appended, and following appended entries back to the kept leaf should bring the combined share under 1%; wrong if it stays over 2.5%. Record: ~/kept-from-tmp/2026-10-31/chat-open-time/fixes/queue-replay-2/RESULT.md.
- `server/deep-freeze.ts` (new): `deepFreeze(value)`, skipping objects already frozen.
- `server/task-queue.ts`: `ReplaySlot` keeps `out` (frozen, what every read gets) and, on the `apply()` path only, `raw` (changed in place by appended entries). `replayState` returns `out` with no copy; it is made again (`deepFreeze(stateOf(readers.replay(...)))`, or `deepFreeze(cloneReplayState(raw))`) only when a queue entry is appended. `taskQueueFromEntries` builds each shown task on its own copy (`shownTask`: drops `heldFrom`/`stuckAt`/`back`/`askLead` as before, adds `waitingFor`/`waitingForRefs`, copies `block` with its refs, filling own-queue refs through `ownQueueRef`, and copies `outside`'s refs, which `queue-blocks.ts` `enrich` fills in afterwards), with the same keys in the same order as before. `taskQueueAll` hands out the frozen tasks (its readers only read them).
- `pi-queue` companion (same task): `replay` hands out its kept state frozen instead of a `cloneState` per read; `branchState` follows appended entries back to its kept leaf through `getEntry` and replays only when one of them is a queue entry.
- Checks: `tests/unit/task-queue.test.ts` ("H-QUEUE-REPLAY-2: reads share one frozen replayed state", also run against `pi-queue`'s readers by `tests/unit/task-queue-canonical.test.ts`): no `structuredClone` on re-reads without a new queue entry (fails on the old code), the shared state is frozen and throws when changed, the panel's view is its own (changing its blocks, refs and tasks leaves the next read as it was), and incremental equals a full replay before and after a queue entry is appended. The `queue-replay-incremental` tests stay.
- Undo: revert this commit and `pi-web-deploy` it (and revert `pi-queue`'s companion commit + `pi-web-deploy restart`).
